name: llm-ahp-mcdm
description: From a data set to an AHP decision: EDA, criteria and hierarchy, performance matrix, criteria weights from LLM respondents (subagents of your Claude Code session, or OpenRouter models), consistency checks and revision, TOPSIS/ARAS/EDAS ranking. The skill runs the ahp-bench command (pip install git+https://github.com/baa-git/llm-ahp-mcdm@v1.0.0).
